turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to debug this Python script that's failing on the import statement.
Hi Alan. Can you share the error message? It might be a path issue or a missing dependency.
It says ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pandas'. I just installed it though.
Did you install it in the same virtual environment you're using to run the script?

Ah, right. I was using the global pip. Let me switch environments. Also, while I'm at it, do you know how selective it is to get into the UK Number 10 Data Science team? I heard the acceptance rate is insanely low, like 0.7%.
That is indeed very competitive. It's not uncommon for top government tech teams to have such rigorous filtering.
Yeah, crazy. Okay, switching env now... ah, that fixed it. Thanks.
Great! Let me know if you hit any other bugs.
